question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**were**" is the past tense form of "to be" used with plural subjects. (थे)
 
• In the context of the passage, the subject **"they" is plural, requiring the past tense plural verb "were."**
 
• The other options: "is," "been," and "had" do not fit the grammatical structure needed to convey the correct meaning in the past tense with a plural subject.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** They were__ installed on an experimental basis and the results were not encouraging despite the heavy expenditure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Is (है)**: the present tense singular form of "to be."
 
• **Been (हुआ है)**: the past participle of "to be," used in perfect tenses.
 
• **Had (था)**: the past tense of "to have," used with perfect tenses.
